subject: Subscription tax classification and VAT ID evidence request
messages:
From: Kylie Hanson <billing@nimbushealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: finance@nimbushealth.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: VAT treatment for monthly subscription (urgent)

Hi Sean,

Quick one — our accounting team flagged the most recent invoice (INV-5792) and want to confirm whether Redwood is charging UK VAT on the monthly subscription or whether this should be reverse-charged. We are a B2B customer and have an active UK VAT registration (VAT GB123456789).

Two asks:
- Can you confirm the tax line you applied on the invoice and the tax rate used?
- If reverse-charge applies, can you reissue the invoice with the correct tax treatment and include a VAT cross-charge note?

I attached their VAT certificate for reference (nimbus-vat-cert-2026.pdf).

Kylie Hanson
Billing Manager, NimbusHealth
billing@nimbushealth.com
Attachment: nimbus-vat-cert-2026.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Kylie Hanson <billing@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: VAT treatment for monthly subscription (urgent)

Hi Kylie — thanks for the note and for sending the certificate.

Quick summary from our side:
- System invoice INV-5792 currently shows 20% UK VAT charged on the subscription line.
- For B2B customers with a valid UK VAT number and services supplied remotely, our standard practice is to apply reverse-charge (zero-rated on our side with a note that customer accounts for VAT).

I'm looping in Monica from Billing to confirm the invoice reissue process and Marissa to handle any accounting entries for the month. We'll confirm next steps and turnaround time.

Next steps we propose:
1) Monica to validate the VAT number against VIES and confirm certificate authenticity.
2) If valid, we will void and reissue INV-5792 as a corrected invoice showing reverse-charge language and zero VAT from Redwood.
3) Provide a short note for Nimbus' records explaining the correction (we can include DocuSign if they need signed confirmation).

I'll follow up once Monica has the VIES check.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 13:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: VAT treatment for monthly subscription (urgent)

Sean — I ran the VIES check and also reviewed the attached PDF. Results:
- VAT GB123456789 matches VIES and is active as of 2026-06-20.
- Certificate looks legitimate (company name + VAT id match invoice billing contact).

Plan to correct:
- Void INV-5792 (system credit memo) and create INV-5792-CORR dated 2026-06-21. Correct invoice will:
  * Show subscription net amount with no VAT applied by Redwood
  * Include the statement: "Reverse charge — Customer liable to account for VAT under Article 196 of Council Directive 2006/112/EC"
  * Reference original INV-5792 and include the attached VAT certificate filename in the comments field.

Timing: I can process the void + reissue within 3 business hours. Please confirm extended billing contacts if we should copy a different Finance address.

Marissa — can you confirm whether we need to post a journal entry for the VAT adjustment this period or whether the credit memo is sufficient for month-end? Also, if we are changing the tax treatment, do we need to flag this to Revenue Ops for reporting?

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Billing Operations Lead
Attachment: internal-vies-screenshot.png (image/png)

From: Kylie Hanson <billing@nimbushealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: finance@nimbushealth.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 16:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: VAT treatment for monthly subscription (urgent)

Thanks — this is perfect and fast, appreciate the quick turnaround.

Please reissue to the same billing contact (finance@nimbushealth.com) and include the reverse charge statement and the VAT certificate filename so our AP team can reconcile quickly. We don't need a DocuSign — a machine-readable invoice with the correction is fine.

Kylie
Billing Manager, NimbusHealth
Attachment: INV-5792.pdf (application/pdf)
